questions.text: You flip a fair coin repeatedly until the pattern TH (tails heads) appears as a run of consecutive flips. What is the expected number of flips?
questions.working: First-step analysis on the KMP states of TH: E_s = 1 + sum_c P(c) E_next(s,c), E_2 = 0. A failed match falls back to the longest prefix that is still a suffix of what you have, which is why overlapping patterns take longer.

questions.text: 3 people each pick a number uniformly from 1..10, independently. What is the probability that at least two pick the same number?
